scope: Sampled rigid-piece deployment, measured against final assembly contacts. Not engineering or manufacturing certification.

layouts.method: Actual transformed connected mesh-component OBB SAT with 0.1 mm excess-over-final-baseline threshold. Final structural joints retained as explicit baseline contacts, not hidden claims of fabrication clearance.
